integrity.rerun_detail: audit G2 D-1 (2026-10-06): set-target status rule set-family-1 - VAL operating points, statuses, tau and the pooled and per-dataset test gates of a set member use only windows unambiguous for it (a set window {walking, brisk_walking} / {recumbent, seated_likely} / {walking, brisk_walking, stationary} no longer counts as correct for whichever member is predicted); set families are scored as one class (reported only); locomotion merges are directed specific->general (brisk_walking->walking, stairs->walking). Bundle retrained from clean commit 744e33a7: heads, calibration and OOD reference identical to the previously sealed bundle; statuses, tau, merges, families and provenance change. Ledger entries now also record per-dataset test-split reuse (G2 D-2).
